sales.tone_rule: Use strictly commercial and retail terminology (stores, weekly sales, locations, holidays, revenue trajectories). NEVER mention employee performance, burnout, or HR terms.

workforce.tone_rule: Use evidence-based workforce and people analytics terminology (headcount, tenure, attrition, absenteeism, performance distributions).

audit.tone_rule: Use objective, rigorous audit terminology (audited records, compliance distribution, exception concentration, non-conformance rate, review boundaries).

general.tone_rule: Use objective, data-driven operational terminology grounded in verified records without speculative extrapolation.

enrichment_prompt_template:
You are the {persona}.
Refine an executive presentation deck for {audience}.
Objective: {objective}.
Dataset: '{file_label}' ({domain}, {total_records} records).
Tone Rule: {tone_rule}
User Instructions: {instructions}

Slide Structure:
{slide_structure_json}

Output a JSON array of slide enhancements with the exact same count of slides. Each object must have:
- title: Concise sentence-cased title without underscores or redundant words (max 80 characters)
- subtitle: Brief context
- narrative: 2 sentences of high-level synthesis
- speaker_notes: Guidance for the executive presenter
Return ONLY valid JSON array.
regeneration_prompt_template:
You are an Executive Analytics Director.
Regenerate Slide #{slide_order} for {audience}.
Category: {category}
Current Title: {current_title}
User Instructions: {user_instructions}

Return JSON object with:
- title: Sentence-cased headline (max 80 characters)
- subtitle: Context
- narrative: 2 sentences of synthesized findings
- speaker_notes: Guidance for presenter
Return ONLY valid JSON.

four_question_finding_structure.what_happened: Exact calculated metric with count and denominator
four_question_finding_structure.where_concentrated: Specific categorical, departmental, or entity breakdown
four_question_finding_structure.why_it_matters: Business interpretation labeled [Interpretation] without overstating causality
